title: Putin touts Russia’s economy at APEC as Ukraine sends it toward a fuel crisis
summary_full: A ramp-up in Ukrainian strikes on oil refineries has knocked out about half of Russia’s refining output, analysts say, and is darkening an already bleak economic outlook.
